_note: House style for generated contracts, measured from LeapSwitch's approved MSA format (owner-supplied, 2025-07; spec in clm-rnd/08-PHASE1-UI-DESIGN-PASS.md § MSA house style). The shell DOCX is BUILT from these values at render time by legalmind.drafting.render_contract.house_shell (no binary in the repository, reviewable as text). Fonts must be installed on the worker that runs LibreOffice, or the PDF substitutes them (Times New Roman → the metric-compatible Liberation Serif).
_spacing_note: [before, after] in pt, by style (Round 6, owner 2026-11-04: the approved file's look, cleaned to enterprise-contract standard): every clause, sub-clause, definition and front-matter paragraph 0/6; a level-1 heading 12/6; the gaps the file made with empty paragraphs (before the parties, WHEREAS, NOW THEREFORE, clause 1 and the execution block) are front_gap_pt before, never an empty paragraph; table cells, header and footer 0/0.

page._top_note: The approved file's top margin is 25.4 mm, but its header holds three empty lines that push every page's text down to 34.3 mm; the house sets that effective top as the margin, with an empty header.

_ladder_note: Hanging-indent ladder, twips (1440 = 1 inch). clause_ladder: per level [number position, text position]; the number is RIGHT-aligned at its position (lvlJc right) and its text starts 0.25in later - one ladder for the whole document (Round 6: clauses 1-2 no longer on their own); each level steps in 0.5in, as the approved format's 1. / 1.1. / 1.1.1. list (text at 0.5in, 1in, 1.5in …). number_suffix follows the number at every level. list: [number offset from the clause's text, gutter] for (a) items. party / recital: [text position, hang] for the A. B. lists. The reading view (frontend components/workspace/reading.ts HANG) uses the same ladder in em at 12pt (1em = 240 twips).

table._rows_note: the paired signature table: [label, row height twips] in order (Sign: the file's three-line cell, 1309); a row shows only when it applies (Authority when a row has one, Common seal / Witness when the template asks). pair_twips: [label, value] per party for two parties — the file's 9165 tw total, both labels 1440 tw (equal, and "Date of sign" fits one line; the file had 1380/1410); more parties share the width with label_twips labels.
table._annexure_rows_note: AM-307: the lines both parties complete under the Special Conditions annexure (coordinator 2026-11-04, research R-5/R-6, Q-5 open for the lawyer): [label, row height twips], in the signature table's style
